chunks: As for what al-Tatari narrated from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Hammad, from Amr ibn Yahya, he said:

I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who performed salat facing other than the qiblah, then the qiblah became clear to him while he had already entered the time of another salat. He said: He repeats it before performing this one whose time has entered.

key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the direction of prayer that must be faced in salat
key_terms.صَلَاةٍ أُخْرَى: another prayer whose time has begun
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time of a salat

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he discovers after salat that he prayed facing other than the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who performed salat facing other than the qiblah and later discovered the correct direction. If the time of another salat has already begun, he must first repeat the earlier salat before performing the current one.
